name: signal-keyboard-demo
description: A two-page polyphonic keyboard and Web Audio receiver demo

scripts.cert: mkdir -p certs && LAN_IP=$(ipconfig getifaddr en0 2>/dev/null || ipconfig getifaddr en1 2>/dev/null || echo 127.0.0.1) && openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout certs/localhost-key.pem -out certs/localhost-cert.pem -days 365 -subj "/CN=localhost" -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:localhost,IP:127.0.0.1,IP:$LAN_IP"
